title: Vendor Enumerations
description: Canonical vendor vocabularies, owned by PRO. Adapters map their codes TO these values, never the reverse. Add members over minor versions; never repurpose one.

VendorStatus.description: ACTIVE = a current vendor. INACTIVE = no new activity. Temporary stops on an ACTIVE vendor are expressed as vendor.blocks (purchasing and/or payment), not as a status.

VendorAddressType.description: MAIN = the vendor's primary address. REMIT_TO = payment address when different.

ContactRole.description: Function the contact serves for PRO. Code routes on these (e.g. ORDERS receives Excel POs, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE receives remittance advice).

SupplyModel.description: WAREHOUSE = vendor ships to a PRO warehouse; PRO receives and sells from stock. DIRECT_SHIP = vendor ships to the retailer, bills PRO, and PRO rebills the retailer.

DirectShipOrderChannel.description: How a DIRECT_SHIP order originates. B2B_PORTAL = retailer orders on the PRO site and PRO transmits it to the vendor. RETAILER_DIRECT = retailer orders the vendor directly; PRO receives a copy.

OrderTransmissionMethod.description: How PRO sends orders to the vendor. EXCEL uses the single PRO standard layout.

InvoiceIntakeMethod.description: How the vendor's invoices reach PRO.

Incoterm.description: Incoterms 2020. Domestic 'FOB Origin' maps to FCA; 'FOB Destination' maps to DAP.

EdiDirection.description: Relative to PRO. INBOUND = vendor sends to PRO.
